newsitem.title: USA: Mercury says NYSE seeking more info.
newsitem.headline: Mercury says NYSE seeking more info.

text.p: Mercury Finance Co said its stock did not trade on the New York Stock Exchange Thursday because the exchange was seeking greater assurances about the accuracy of a statement the company put out Wednesday.

"My understanding is that the New York Stock Exchange wanted the company to provide them with additional assurance that the numbers in the release Wednesday were reliable," said Joseph Kopec, a spokesman for the company.

The exchange also wanted support for Mercury's assessment in the statement that it believes its financial condition remains strong and will support the company's continuing operations and plans for future growth, Kopec said.
Kopec said he did not know if the finance company would issue additional information.
A spokesman for the exchange said, "We want to ensure there is complete disclosure."
The stock has not traded on the NYSE since it closed at 14-7/8 Tuesday.
The company said Wednesday it had restated its earnings for the past four years due to accounting irregularities, lowering earnings by about $90 million total.
